fields.title: Qualify a second supplier for 12 oz cups and lids
fields.cause: Pacific Pulp is our only source of 12 oz cups, is late on one delivery in five, and the contract ends Dec 31.
fields.plan: RFQ to three cup makers this week; trial 20,000 cups in six cafés; decide before the contract talks.

fields.title: Claim credit for 1,150 cracked lids
fields.cause: Lot L-2241 failed inspection: 2.4% of lids cracked.
fields.plan: Send the inspection photos and lot numbers; ask for a credit note and a corrective action report.

fields.title: Dispute Altura’s freight surcharge against the contract
fields.cause: The forward contract prices coffee delivered to Oakland; a $0.11/lb surcharge adds about $35K a year.
fields.plan: Send the contract clause and the October invoice lines; ask for a credit and written confirmation that the surcharge is dropped.

fields.title: Audit Northline’s accessorial charges and temperature logs
fields.cause: One invoice in five carries charges not on the PO, three loads broke the cold chain, and the contract ends Jan 31.
fields.plan: Hold the nine disputed invoices; request the October temperature logs; meet Northline with both before deciding to renew.

fields.title: Settle Valley Oat’s renewal terms before Dec 15
fields.cause: On watch with the contract ending in six weeks: price creep and slower deliveries.
fields.plan: Renew only at the contract price with a delivery-day commitment; Bellweather’s oat trial is the fallback.

fields.title: Confirm Q4 maintenance visits for all 38 cafés
fields.cause: Routine, not risk: quarterly maintenance before the holiday rush.
fields.plan: All 38 visits booked and done by Oct 31.
